say:1:1710830701:1.text: The barrier's holding! Diza, that was brilliant.
say:1:1710830701:1.source_cn: 屏障生效了！迪兹，你也太厉害了！

say:2:1710830702:1.text: Don't celebrate yet. The barrier can defend us, but it can't attack the monsters.
say:2:1710830702:1.source_cn: 别高兴得太早。屏障只能防御，不能攻击魔物。

say:3:1710830703:1.text: If we want to ease the pressure on the Royal Guard, we'll have to go on the offensive.
say:3:1710830703:1.source_cn: 必须想办法主动出击，减轻守备军的压力。

say:4:1710830704:1.text: You mean... the two of us?
say:4:1710830704:1.source_cn: 啊？主动出击？我们两个吗？

say:6:1710830705:1.text: Captain Gwyneth, I have another proposal.
say:6:1710830705:1.source_cn: ……格温妮丝队长，关于这点我还有一个提议。

say:8:1710830707:1.text: When Savannah was first built, <style="highlight">defensive golems</style> were installed at key locations across the city in preparation for war.
say:8:1710830707:1.source_cn: 赛凡纳在建城之初，为了应对战争，在城市的几个关键节点设...

say:9:1710830708:1.text: Golems? You mean those statues in the plaza? I thought those were decorative.
say:9:1710830708:1.source_cn: 魔像？你是说广场上的那些石像？那不是装饰品吗？

say:10:1710830709:1.text: ... When we're done here, you are rereading "The History of Urban Magical Defense" from cover to cover.
say:10:1710830709:1.source_cn: ……回去之后我一定要让你重修《城市魔法防御史》！

say:11:1710830710:1.text: They're ancient magical weapons. Once awakened, they'll automatically seek and destroy any Hypofiends in the vicinity.
say:11:1710830710:1.source_cn: 其实那些是古老的魔法兵器，一旦唤醒，它们就会自动索敌并...

say:12:1710830711:1.source_cn: 不过这种魔像有一些弊端……

say:14:1710830713:1.text: Their mana cores overheat. After a period of time, they shut down and enter a cooling state.
say:14:1710830713:1.source_cn: 它们的魔力驱动装置容易过热，运作一段时间后，会自动停止...

say:15:1710830714:1.text: When that happens, someone needs to manually reset the switch beside each golem to force it back online.
say:15:1710830714:1.source_cn: 到时候，需要有人手动再开启魔像旁的开关，再次强制唤醒，...

say:17:1710830715:1.text: You're saying we'd have to run out there and reset them while monsters are swarming? That's suicide!
say:17:1710830715:1.source_cn: 在魔物攻击的情况下，跑去再开启开关吗？那也太危险了。

say:18:1710830716:1.text: That's not all. To awaken them the first time, Dali and I must perform the activation ritual on site.
say:18:1710830716:1.source_cn: 不仅如此。初次唤醒它们，更需要我和达利在现场进行魔法激活。

say:19:1710830717:1.text: During the process, we cannot move, or defend ourselves.
say:19:1710830717:1.source_cn: 在这个过程中，我们完全无法移动，也没办法保护自己。

say:20:1710830718:1.source_cn: 明白了。我来护送你们去。

say:21:1710830719:1.text: I'll guard you during the activation and handle the resets afterward.
say:21:1710830719:1.source_cn: 无论是激活时的护卫，还是后续的重启工作，都交给我。

say:22:1710830720:1.text: No, Captain! You've already pushed yourself past your limits! Let us take this one!
say:22:1710830720:1.source_cn: 不行！队长！您已经透支了！这种任务让我们去就行！

say:24:1710830721:1.text: Yeah! We'll guard the mages with our lives if we have to!
say:24:1710830721:1.source_cn: 对！我们哪怕拼上性命，也会保护好两位魔法师大人的！

say:25:1710830722:1.text: Request denied. The area is overrun. You'd need to hold position for extended periods and operate the switches in the middle of combat.
say:25:1710830722:1.source_cn: 驳回。那里全是魔物，而且需要长时间坚守原地，甚至还要在...

say:26:1710830723:1.text: You're tired and your equipment is worn down. You wouldn't survive that kind of sustained assault.
say:26:1710830723:1.source_cn: 那种烈度的围攻，凭你们现在的装备和体力，根本守不住。

say:28:1710830725:1.text: No arguments. It's dangerous. That's precisely why I'm going.
say:28:1710830725:1.source_cn: 没有可是。这很危险，正因为危险，所以我才必须亲自去。

say:29:1710830726:1.text: Listen carefully. The barrier's up, but the civilians still need reassurance. Hold this position. That's an order.
say:29:1710830726:1.source_cn: 听着，屏障虽然建立了，但民众还需要人安抚。守好这里，这...

say:32:1710830728:1.text: Mages, prepare to move. I'll clear us a path.
say:32:1710830728:1.source_cn: 二位魔法师，准备出发吧。我会为你们开辟出一条路来。
